name: Eren
site: sunrise.ch · Mobile, internet and TV provider, Switzerland
headline: Turn Sunrise’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells mobile plans, home internet, TV and roaming to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive for 5G, fibre or a 33% device discount on the promotions banner.

Once a customer is with you, data use, roaming trips, TV viewing and the add-ons they never touch are the clearest signals for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today they sit in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from data use, roaming, TV viewing and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each mobile, internet and TV customer, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next plan when it fits
cases.text: Next best plan, add-on or bundle per customer, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade mails to customers already on the right tariff.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep each customer using their services weekly
cases.text: Personal nudges for TV viewing, data add-ons and roaming packs in app, email and on your site, orchestrated so each customer sees a reason to use Sunrise this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
